extraction.Name: Mary Rosa Guerue Bettelyoun
extraction.Occupation/Income: My husband works at odd jobs.
extraction.NOTES: Six children depend on her for support; received patent by mail, does not remember the date; did not make application for patent; states 'I do not think it was right to give us the patent when we did not ask for it'; sold land for $1700.00 cash and a Ford car valued at $500.00; sale was not satisfactory but needed money to fix up another place; purchaser gave her all he agreed to; not in good health; subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-52, on 27th day of May 1929
